answer: The sable schedule is applied in sparrow and shale reveals each instalment. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and as a result 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4909 identities would post 2399 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
